# CORE-STR-04

**Is every service deployed to a node, and every store owned by one service?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | STR: Structure |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | design.type is solution-design |

## Rule

Every service has deployed_to resolving to a deployment-node; every data set's owner resolves to an element.
